tool.name: Make.clr
tool.description: Make a centered log-ratio transformed shared file

param.name: label
param.label: label - select OTU distance labels
param.help: all labels are used if none are selected

param.name: groups
param.label: groups - Groups to include
param.help: all groups are used if none are selected

param.label: zero - value used to replace zero OTU abundances
param.help: The centered log-ratio is undefined for a zero count, mothur replaces those with this value. Default 1.0

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The make.clr_ command reads a shared_ file and outputs a centered log-ratio (CLR) transformed version of it, i.e. for every group and OTU the logarithm of the abundance divided by the geometric mean of the group. A zero abundance is undefined in the log-ratio, hence the `zero` parameter that replaces it (default 1.0).
Because the transformed values are no longer counts, the output is a plain tabular file that keeps the shared file layout (label, Group, numOtus, OTU columns).
.. _make.clr: https://mothur.org/wiki/make.clr/ .. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/Shared_file
